purpose: Test whether large Stage-B2 person/rater movement is explained by structural rank deficiency and person-rater graph disconnection.

audit.coordinate_space: exact free coordinates after hard anchors and centering constraints
audit.graph: undirected bipartite Person-Rater incidence graph on observed rows

interpretation_rules.full_rank: No exact linear-predictor null direction was detected under the fitted identification constraints.
interpretation_rules.rank_deficient: The JMLE likelihood is structurally invariant along at least one exact free-coordinate direction; optimizer convergence cannot make all affected parameters uniquely estimable.
interpretation_rules.person_rater_components_gt_1: Person-rater disconnection or nesting can create separate location shifts unless anchors or cross-rater overlap remove them.
interpretation_rules.integration_rule: Any retained design class with structural nullity greater than zero blocks unconditional JMLE integration for that class.
